name: Golden A/S Customer
subtitle: Projects, documents, offers
promotionalText: Follow your Golden A/S projects, sign documents, decide on offers and reach our engineers — from your phone.
description:
Golden A/S Customer is the application for the owners, captains and technical managers of vessels whose electrical, automation and navigation systems are built or serviced by Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S).

Access is by invitation from your Golden A/S project manager; the app is a companion to the Golden A/S customer portal.

With it you can:
• follow the progress of your projects and sub-projects, vessel by vessel
• review and approve drawings and documents submitted for owner approval, with comments
• sign field service reports and acceptance documents on the device
• see the offers issued to you and accept or decline them
• open support tickets for your vessels and follow their resolution
• read the project documentation and the service history of your equipment

Sign-in with password and authenticator code, or with Face ID / Touch ID and passkeys after the first sign-in. Your data stays on the Golden A/S portal and is never shared with third parties. Available in English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian and Bulgarian.
whatsNew: First App Store release of the Golden A/S Customer app: project progress, document approval, signing, offers, tickets, documents, passkeys.
reviewNotes:
Companion app of the Golden A/S customer portal for the owners and captains of vessels we work on. Accounts are created by Golden A/S when a project starts, so a sign-in is required.

Please sign in with the demo account provided (a customer user of a demo fleet; no real customer data). No authenticator code is needed for this account. After sign-in: Home shows the action centre; Sign lists documents for approval (open one to see the PDF and the Review / Sign buttons); Offers shows issued offers; Tickets lets you open a support request. Passkeys and push notifications are optional.
